# Month heat grid (`month-grid`)

Calendar heat map with legend.

Group: Charts & instruments. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/charts';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createMonthGrid` (types in `dist/web/charts/monthGrid.d.ts`): `.mh-month-grid`: a calendar heat map. One cell per day, coloured in `steps` strengths of `--mh-series-N` or the accent from the lowest to the highest value; days without data are outlined only. A real table, so screen readers can move by week and weekday and hear each day's value; the legend reads out the scale.

```ts
export function createMonthGrid(options: MonthGridOptions): MonthGridHandle;

export interface MonthGridOptions {
  year: number;
  /** 1 (January) to 12. */
  month: number;
  /** One value per day, day 1 first; `null` (or missing) is a day without data. */
  values: readonly (number | null)[];
  /** What it shows ("Energy used per day"). */
  label: string;
  color?: ChartColor;
  /** Bottom and top of the colour scale; default the data's own range. */
  min?: number;
  max?: number;
  /** Number of colour steps, 2 to 6 (default 4). */
  steps?: number;
  /** First day of the week, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (default 1, Monday). */
  weekStart?: number;
  /** Locale for the month and weekday names; default the user's. */
  locale?: string;
  /** Day of the month to outline as today. */
  today?: number;
  /** The visible caption; default the month and year ("March 2026"). */
  caption?: string;
  /** The colour scale under the grid (default true). */
  legend?: boolean;
  size?: ChartSize;
  format?: (value: number) => string;
}

export interface MonthGridHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(options: MonthGridOptions): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createMonthGrid } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Energy used per day in March; days after today have no data yet.
const energy = [
  6.1, 5.4, 7.2, 4.8, 5.9, 8.3, 8.8, 5.1, 6.0, 5.7, 4.9, 6.4, 9.1,
  8.6, 5.3, 5.8, 6.2, 4.6, 5.5, 8.7, 9.4, 6.0, 5.2, 4.7, 6.3,
];

const grid = createMonthGrid({
  year: 2026,
  month: 3,
  values: energy,
  label: 'Energy used per day',
  today: 25,
  format: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)} kWh`,
});

document.body.append(grid.el);
```
